text:
reena: Heads-up: we're scheduling a tiered canary for `zephyr-mini` next Tue 02:00 UTC. This one slices traffic by customer tier (free -> paid -> enterprise) to catch regressions that correlate with payload size.

own: TL;DR plan: free tier 10m @ 2%, paid tier 20m @ 10%, enterprise 30m @ 15%, then evaluate for 1h before full. Keep fallback ordering per-tier (different lists) so enterprise falls back to higher-quality alt first.

maria: Proposed fallback lists: free -> [legacy-small, zephyr-alt-quant, degen], paid -> [zephyr-alt-quant, legacy-slim, degen], enterprise -> [zephyr-alt-lg, zephyr-alt-quant, legacy-slim]. These are strict-ordered, not probabilistic.

reena: Good. We also want a soft-rollback window: autopin suggestions for the operator when signals cross thresholds, plus a one-command global-pin if needed.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight running. Checks: model checksum ok, model-variant compatibility ok, autoscaler sanity ok. Telemetry hooks: token-level tracing, model-compare metrics, and per-tier error aggregation attached. Autopin thresholds suggested: p95 > +20% vs baseline for 10m OR tier-specific error-rate > 0.5% for enterprise / 1% for paid / 2% for free. Autopin will only create a PENDING pin event, operator must ACK to execute.

opsbot: opsbot note: do KV priming per-tier to avoid cold-start noise. Command (run during each 10m initial window):
```sh
curl -s -X POST https://internal-cache/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"zephyr-mini","tier":"<tier>","prompts":20}'
```
Also reduce cache TTLs to 15s for the first 45m across regions, revert afterwards.

sam: I'll take emergency rollback/pin ownership. Runbook: 1) `platformctl pin --model=zephyr-stable --scope=global` OR scope=region/tier for partial pins. 2) set weights back to 0 for canary variants. 3) post update to #customer-uptime. If autopin PENDING appears, I will ACK within 120s or trigger immediate pin if severity high.

maria: QA will run stress and long-sequence evals at 01:20-01:40 UTC and paste a short log here. Please ensure perf harness includes 2x token-length and multi-turn workloads.

tanya: Small ops ask: during enterprise slice keep KV TTL slightly higher (30s) to better simulate customer caches; for free slice use 10s so we can flush fast.

reena: Release notes: change window 02:00-05:00 UTC, customer-impact: low-to-medium for free tier (brief latency blips), rollout owner = @reena, rollback owner = @sam. I'll draft and post to #release-notes.

own: One extra: fallback metric alignment. We need to map fallback rank -> SLA weight so our routing stats reflect expected tail behavior. Ops team, please add a metric tag `fallback_rank` to rollout traces.

deploybot: Preflight complete. Manual approval required at go-time. Start command: `/deploy start --model=zephyr-mini --mode=tiered-canary --slices=free,paid,enterprise --safety=on`

reena: Approved. If no objections to per-tier fallbacks or thresholds within 45m we lock plan. Thanks all :rocket:
